Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 151. Category: technique. “Other” Ki Techniques.

Rank 3 Melee technique
Ki Cost: 35 ki
Casting Time: 1 action
Prerequisites: None
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Melee
Chargeable?: No
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: blast
Choose a number of creatures that you can see within
range equal to your Charisma modifier. The target
begins a comic dance in place: shuffling, tapping its feet,
and capering for the duration. Creatures that can’t be
charmed are immune to this spell.
A dancing creature must use all its movement to
dance without leaving its space and has disadvantage on
Dexterity saving throws and attack rolls. While the
target is affected by this technique, other creatures have
advantage on attack rolls against it. As an action, a
dancing creature makes a Wisdom saving throw to
regain control of itself. On a successful save, the effect
ends.
